observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: complex in-phase and quadrature samples preserving amplitude and interferometric phase in slant-range geometry
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: Sentinel-1A or Sentinel-1B platform, full-scene or burst packaging, archive mirror, SAFE processing baseline, polarization and acquisition mode when complex phase remains available
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: GRD or RTC backscatter without complex phase, a derived displacement map without operational use of Sentinel-1 SLC, or SLC observations from another radar mission without Sentinel-1 input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: Sentinel-1A and Sentinel-1B Level-1 SLC products are admitted, including NASA CMR ASF full-scene collections and SLC burst packaging that preserves complex phase. GRD, RTC and backscatter-only products are excluded unless Sentinel-1 SLC is also operationally processed. ALOS/PALSAR and ALOS-2/PALSAR-2 SLC are seed companion inputs, not aliases of the C-band Sentinel-1 anchor.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: A paper need not reproduce the seed's ALOS and ALOS-2 branches, but it must operationally process Sentinel-1 SLC complex data. Interferograms, coherence, unwrapped phase or displacement count only when their derivation from Sentinel-1 SLC is established in Methods/Data.

anchor_repointed.reason: NASA Earthdata CMR exposes the actual Sentinel-1A/B Level-1 SLC collections through ASF. The former GRD anchor removed interferometric phase and changed the observable used by the seed.
anchor_repointed.seed_evidence: The seed processes Sentinel-1A/B ascending track 35 repeat-pass scenes into interferograms and a coherence-weighted SBAS line-of-sight displacement time series, together with ALOS and ALOS-2 SLC branches.
anchor_repointed.verified_against: NASA CMR collections SENTINEL-1A_SLC (C1214470488-ASF), SENTINEL-1B_SLC (C1327985661-ASF), SENTINEL-1_BURSTS (C2709161906-ASF), ALOS_PALSAR_LEVEL1.1 (C1206485527-ASF) and ALOS2_L1_PSR2 (C3315903479-ASF).
anchor_repointed.residual_gap: The supplied task Anchor exposes the Sentinel-1A collection. Sentinel-1B is admitted as the same product family, while the L-band ALOS and ALOS-2 branches remain separate companion collections.
